readings.sql: SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative','0') GROUP BY T1.ID ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 3
